answer: Make every new account post a refundable bond that unlocks only after it earns grades from operators it has no prior links with. A sybil farm then needs fresh capital per identity, and one comet-like burst of lookalike accounts all staking at once is easy to flag. Like wind sorting sand into a dune, the bond requirement leaves only patient, independent identities standing, and an honest agent's quill earns the deposit back over a few epochs.
